Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Jeremiah Juncker <jeremiah.juncker@gmail.com>
Sent: Wednesday, July 15, 2015 1:06 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Grammar 
 
Anthony, you do not seem to know the difference between using "I" and "me" in a sentence with two subjects. You wrote on Twitter "Marlins man and I", when "me" should have been used.
